title: Ecosystems
description: The ecosystem, family, and species tree with inherited mob attributes at every level.

attributes.description: Attribute overrides inherited by families in this ecosystem.
Attribute overrides inherited by species in this family.

id.description: Unique family ID. To be deprecated.
Unique species ID. To be deprecated.

species.description: Species in this family, keyed by name. Names must be unique across all ecosystems.

families.description: Families in this ecosystem, keyed by name. Names must be unique across all ecosystems.

id.description: Unique ecosystem ID. To be deprecated.

animation_speed.description: Animation speed. Falls back to speed when unset.

aggressive.description: Whether it aggroes players on sight. Defaults to false.

flags.description: Combat behaviour switches such as no_turn or raisable. An override replaces the whole list rather than adding to it.

links.description: Whether it links with others of its kind. Defaults to false.

true_detection.description: Whether it sees through sneak and invisible. Defaults to false.

charmable.description: Whether it can be charmed. Defaults to false, and is forced off for notorious, event, fished and battlefield mobs whatever this says.

dmg_mult.description: Base damage multiplier as a percentage. Defaults to 100.

skill.description: Weapon skill type. Defaults to none.

combat.description: Weapon skill, delay and damage multiplier.

detects.description: How it notices players. Defaults to an empty list, and an override replaces the whole list rather than adding to it.

jobs.description: Main and support job, in that order. Always written as a pair, so setting one restates the other.

mob_mods.description: Mob modifiers keyed by mob_mod.yaml name, entry by entry.

mods.description: Modifiers keyed by mod.yaml name, entry by entry, added on top of what the entity already has.

door_id.description: Identity the client reads for a door, elevator or ship. Elevators and ships send it with a timestamp appended. Nothing reads it on a mob.

entity_flags.description: Entity behaviour bitmask sent to the client. Defaults to 0 on a mob and 3 on an npc.

hitbox.description: Hitbox radius in tenths of a yalm. Defaults to 0.

king.description: Whether the entity stays spawned beyond render range. Defaults to false.

body.description: Equipped body model. Omitted means empty.

feet.description: Equipped feet model. Omitted means empty.

hands.description: Equipped hands model. Omitted means empty.

head.description: Equipped head model. Omitted means empty. On a chocobo the slots hold small barding indices, not equipment ids.

legs.description: Equipped legs model. Omitted means empty.

main.description: Equipped main weapon model. Omitted means empty.

model.description: Model id, for standard, misc and automaton.

race.description: Race, for equipped models. On a chocobo this pair carries its colour instead.

ranged.description: Equipped ranged weapon model. Omitted means empty.

sub.description: Equipped sub weapon model. Omitted means empty.

type.description: Which look fields the client reads, matching the packet's SubKind. door, elevator and ship carry no model: the client names them from the packet. standard, misc and automaton each carry one model id under a different SubKind, so the same id means a different model in each. misc is SubKind 5, which the packet code still calls MODEL_UNK_5, and is used by Fomors; automaton is SubKind 6 and covers trolls, lamia and mamool ja despite the name. chocobo reads the same nine fields as equipped.

look.description: Appearance. On a mob it inherits through the species chain; on an npc, omitted means an empty look.

model_size.description: Graphic size the client draws the entity at, 0 to 3. Defaults to 0.

moving.description: Movement flag word sent alongside the position. Defaults to 0.

name_prefix.description: Byte 0x27 of the entity update: gender, plus the article the client shows before the name. Defaults to 0.

render.description: How it is drawn and presented to the client.

all.description: Applies on top of every element.

dmg_magic.description: Magic damage taken, by element, on the same hundredths-of-a-percent scale as dmg_physical.

dmg_physical.description: Physical damage taken, by weapon type, in hundredths of a percent: 0 leaves it alone, -2500 takes a quarter less, 2500 takes a quarter more.

immune_status.description: Statuses that never land, whatever the resistance rank says.

rank_element.description: Resistance to each element. Higher resists more.

rank_status.description: Resistance to each status. Higher resists more.

resists.description: Resistances, entry by entry. Each value replaces the inherited one rather than adding to it.

type.description: Conditions under which it spawns. Defaults to normal.

start.description: Vana'diel hour the mob starts spawning.

window.description: Vana'diel hours it may spawn between. Omitted means any hour.

spawn.description: When and how often it spawns.

speed.description: Movement speed. Defaults to 40, and 0 is immobile.

hp.description: Flat HP, replacing what the level and job would derive. Defaults to 0, meaning derive it.

mp.description: Flat MP, replacing what the level and job would derive. Defaults to 0, meaning derive it.

stats.description: Flat HP and MP plus a rank per stat, a to g, where a is best. Everything defaults to c except attack and accuracy, which default to a and only understand a to e.
